A320 Type Rated Co-Pilots (First Officer / Senior First Officer)

Location:  Gurugram
|
Oct 10, 2026

AIR INDIA GROUP is Inviting Applications from Experienced A320 Type Rated Co-Pilots (First Officer (CPL) / Senior First Offer (ATPL))

This opportunity is with Air India Express.  

Who can Apply:

A320 P2s with

  • Valid A320 Co-Pilot Endorsement.
  • Minimum 500 hours on Airbus 320 Family Aircraft post line Release 
  • Maximum Age Limit – 40 years
  • Maximum Age Limit for Defence Pilots with A320 Rating & ATPL - 45 years
  •  

 

Requirements:

  • Indian Nationals or Overseas citizens of India
  • Valid CPL/ATPL with current/valid IR & Pilot’s Proficiency Check, FRTOL, COP/RTR
  • Valid Medical fitness assessment certificate (Class I)
  • ICAO Aviation English Language Proficiency Four or above endorsed on Indian CPL/ATPL
  • Certificate of incident/ accident free record, breath analyzer and details of enforcement action, if any, taken against the license holder by DGCA
  • Preference shall be given to candidates who are available to join immediately
  • Mandatory eGCA-id with all licenses and documents validated

 

Stages of Selection

  • Psychometric Assessment
  • Personal Interview
  • Simulator Flight Proficiency Test 
  • Pre-Employment Medical Examination

 

Place of Posting  - As per Company Requirements.
